name: Pepper Rasam
steps: Soak tamarind in 150 ml warm measured water for 10 minutes. Squeeze and strain, discarding seeds and fibre. Crush pepper, cumin, coriander seeds and peeled garlic coarsely.
Simmer chopped tomato, tamarind extract, turmeric and salt with the remaining water for 8–10 minutes until the tomato is soft and the raw tamarind aroma fades.
Add the crushed spice mixture and simmer for 3–4 minutes. Stop when a light foam rises at the edges; prolonged hard boiling makes the pepper aroma dull.

Heat ghee separately and pop mustard seeds. Add dried chilli and curry leaves carefully, pour over the rasam and stir in coriander. Cover briefly before serving as a broth or with rice prepared separately.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
